title: Board Clean Refactor
description: Refactor @elements/board and board integration (topology, sketchpad) to be clean: remove legacy APIs, unify naming, consolidate exports, fix inconsistencies, ensure tests pass.
summary: Completed board clean refactor. Board fixture nodes use text-only captions (label rejected at parse); nakagin fixture migrated. Kit diagram uses @elements/board layoutBoardFixtureForceGraph and TopologyBoardPane only (removed legacy React Flow kit diagram and d3-force). Design topology already uses TopologyBoardPane with attraction-based scene connect. Removed snake_case JSON aliases (handle_kind, default_wire_kind, default_edge_kind) from board WASM catalog/fixture ingest. Tests: cargo test -p elements_board 80 passed; board vitest 75 passed; sketchpad vite build succeeded.
